thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — want to schedule a short SLO throughput probe with queue sampling in staging. Goal: validate 99th-pct latency < 120ms for our 4-GPU cb pool under the new batching heuristics. Can someone run a smoke ramp later today?

maya: I can take this. What's the exact plan and config you want me to use?

alex: Thanks! Plan: light ramp 100 -> 800 rps over 10m, hold 5m. Use `max_batch_size=64`, `max_tokens=4096` for the runtime job, and enable `queue_sampling=true` (sample 1/10 requests). Collect per-route token breakdown + KV cache hit rate.

kiran: Small note: with the new windowing change, `max_batch_size=64` might push queueing at 800rps for 128-token avg. Maybe try `max_batch_size=48` as a safety run first.

maya: Good call. I'll spin two runs: safety (48) then target (64). Will attach logs.

sam: FYI there's a `slo-probe` harness in infra-tools (see PR #412). It already supports ramp + sampling and outputs the 99/95/50 latency percentiles to our perf dashboard. Use `infra-tools/slo-probe --staging --rps 800 --ramp 600`.

jules: Quick CR ping — I made a tiny change to the probe config to emit `kv_hit_rate` and `batch_size_hist`. @sam can you review when you get a sec? Link: https://git.internal/infra-tools/pull/412

sam: On it. If it's small I'll merge after green CI.

ops-bot: Scheduled job `slo-throughput-probe-2309876543` created (ETA: 16:30 UTC). Owner: maya.

maya: Running safety run now (max_batch_size=48). Will post the shortlog and dashboard link when done.

ci-bot: CI for PR #412 passed — all checks green.

lee: One more ask — if the 99th spikes above 120ms, can we try enabling `small-batch-fallback=true` and re-run? That should keep p99 bounded at cost of throughput.

alex: Yup — plan B is `small-batch-fallback` + fallback to the faster quantized model variant. We'll decide after safety run.

maya: Safety run finished. Quick numbers: p50 18ms, p95 54ms, p99 128ms, kv_hit_rate ~0.22, median batch_size 36. Dashboard: https://perf.internal/redslo/2309876543

kiran: Interesting — p99 just over SLO. median batch_size 36 suggests we're not filling 48 often. Maybe request mix has short tokens.

alex: OK thanks. Let's do target run with max_batch_size=64 and `small-batch-fallback=true`. Maya — want me to flip the job or you?

maya: I can run it if you merge PR for `batch_size_hist` first — saw CI green. I'll rerun in ~10m.

jules: Merged the tiny config change.

maya: Running target now (64 + small-batch-fallback). Will post results in ~12m.

ops-bot: Job `slo-throughput-probe-2309876543-target` started.

maya: Target run done. p50 20ms, p95 58ms, p99 112ms, kv_hit_rate 0.25, median batch_size 51. Looks within SLO. Logs: /var/logs/slo-probes/2309876543-target.log

alex: Great! Can someone add a short note to the perf playbook summarizing config and backstop (small-batch-fallback + quantized fallback)?

sam: I'll add the note and a small checklist for future probes.

lee: Thanks everyone. Closing loop — will include these numbers in the weekly runtime sync deck. :tada:

maya: Thanks all — feel free to re-run if anyone wants different token distributions.
